messages.author: 0d7ec88b0d9f4a0d
messages.subject: Support for DataTable DT_RowId
parts:
I don't think Shiny currently supports the DataTable DT_RowId feature which allows the server to specify unique row id's that DataTable places on the tr elements as id attributes. (http://www.datatables.net/examples/server_side/ids.html)
This would be a very useful feature for applications where the client needs to communicate with the server about specific rows in the table.  It makes row identification logic much cleaner on both client and server and removes the current limitation that the visible columns in the table must contain sufficient information to uniquely identify the row.

Currently when a user clicks on a table row my application client code needs to pull data from a set of td elements that constitute a unique row identifier and send this back to R, and then the R code has to match this to the data frame.  It would be cleaner if R could specify e.g. the row.names or row numbers as DT_RowId in renderDataTable and then just pull them off the tr's and send them back to R. 

Ron
